headline: Sofia begins one of the largest investment programmes in its history
summary: Sofia Municipality officially announced the next step in implementing one of the most ambitious investment programmes in the city's history. Details of the programme were not included in the summary.
why: Large municipal investment programmes create construction and infrastructure contracts for local companies and influence city finances. They affect the economic outlook for the capital.
